messages:
kim_marketing: quick heads-up 4 final draft of the launch blog is live: https://docs.example.com/launch-final-draft. Need fast passes on benchmark wording, regional CTAs, JP/DE short copies, and the inbound routing snippet. hoping to lock by tomorrow noon. :spiral_calendar:

alex_growth: Ill take CTAs + A/B plan. Proposal: Webinar-first vs Quickstart-first by region. GA events: launch.variant and launch.cta.

nina_pm: Bench source = internal bench-v3 on identical A100 configs. Current copy says "30% faster p99"  prefer "~30% lower p99 latency (internal tests)." Please include the methodology block.

omar_legal: Legal note: avoid superlatives. Suggested copy: "Based on internal benchmark v3 comparing Redwood runtime to OpenModelX on identical hardware. Methodology: 3,000 requests; mixed sequence lengths; p99 measured across 5 runs." Replace "guarantee"/"industry-leading."

sara_ops: Ops routing mapping to add to playbook: ```region_map = {"NA":"sales-na","EU":"sales-eu","APAC":"partners-apac"}``` Webinar capacity: EU slots Tue/Thu 10am CET, capacity 40 -> auto-waitlist at 40. Also append UTM: `?utm_source=blog&utm_campaign=prod_launch&utm_variant=A|B`.

kims_marketing: Thanks all  pasted legal wording and methodology into the draft and swapped superlatives to "industry-competitive." Link updated: https://docs.example.com/launch-final-draft#v2.

alex_growth: CTA short copies (<=45 chars):
- Variant A (webinar): "Join our launch webinar" -> tags: `lead:webinar`, `route:region-based`
- Variant B (quickstart): "Read the quickstart & deploy" -> tags: `lead:docs`, `route:docs-flow`
JP short (webinar): "" // will paste final in doc
DE short (webinar): "Live-Demo: Jetzt anmelden"

omar_legal: LGTM after tiny edits: change "controlled tests" -> "controlled internal tests" and move methodology to its own sentence.

nina_pm: Made those edits and updated the benchmark line to "~30% lower p99 latency (internal tests)." Pushed v3.

reminder-bot: Draft freeze in 18 hours for pipeline scheduling.

kim_marketing: If no objections by noon tomorrow I'll lock copy and hand to ops for scheduling. Thanks everyone! :rocket:
